spans.text: Those that refuse to adapt to new technology will be disadvantaged,
We’re always moving towards places of higher leverage where we can do more at a higher quality with less effort and so knowing that principle,
We’re not going to magically go back to a pre-AI world we’re only ever going to get more entrenched in it.
at cheaper prices, with better integration within our systems so that we can always keep doing more work at a higher quality with less.
Rather than slamming the brakes and being forced to ingest and dissipate our own inertia and new unfamiliar forces.
Figure out what you wish to champion and use the tools to champion your cause.
